senses.sense_definition: The ability to decide how to act in a sensible way and the initiative to do so.

examples.text: She had the <w>gumption</w> to ask for a raise when she knew the company was doing well.
It takes a lot of <w>gumption</w> to start your own business in such a difficult economy.

senses.sense_definition: Boldness and courage in taking action or starting new projects.

examples.text: He lacked the <w>gumption</w> to stand up to his boss when he knew he was right.
You need real <w>gumption</w> to move to a foreign country without knowing the language.

senses.sense_definition: High levels of energy and enthusiasm for life and work.

examples.text: The young intern was full of <w>gumption</w> and always eager to take on new tasks.
After a long vacation, she returned to the office with renewed <w>gumption</w>.
